# vendor/

`evidence_kit/`: a pinned copy of the series' evidence-kit **5.2.0** (`../../evidence-kit/evidence_kit`, VERSION 5.2.0),
copied 2026-10-04 per the series rule "copy, don't link". The proof pack uses `evidence_kit.proof` (the Production AI
Engineering Proof Contract v1, `pae-proof/v1`: check evaluation, claim tracing, results, SHA256SUMS, schema validation,
secret scan, run comparison, the PROOF VERIFICATION report), `evidence_kit.facts` (the fact registry) and
`evidence_kit.publication` (the local-path scan). The contract itself is `evidence_kit/proof_contract/PROOF_STANDARD.md`.
